title: Public Service Amendment (Payments in Special Circumstances) Bill 2011 [2013]
short_title: Public Service Amendment (Payments in Special Circumstances) Bill 2011 [2013]

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would remove the monetary ceiling on discretionary special circumstances payments under public service law, allowing agencies to consider compensation above the existing limit.
Agencies using section 73 could approve payments above $100,000, including for people seeking compensation after defective administration where a separate compensation scheme does not apply.
The proposal addresses compensation sought after defective administration at agencies such as Comcare, which is outside the existing scheme for that type of claim.
changes: The bill would delete subsection 73(4) from the Public Service Act 1999.
Special circumstances payments would no longer be subject to that provision's $100,000 limit.
The amendment would take effect on the day following royal assent.
summary.affected: Comcare, other agencies able to make special circumstances payments and people seeking compensation for defective administration are affected.
